description_en: Syncs department information to Alibaba Business Travel (Alitrip), typically used to create a new department
description_zh: 通过调用本接口可以实现向阿里商旅中同步部门信息，通常用于向阿里商旅中新增部门
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen add-department --out-dept-id out_dept_0001 --dept-name '系统研发部' --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddDepartment

parameters.help_en:
The custom department ID defined by the enterprise.
Ensure that this parameter value is unique.
The default root department ID is 1. Do not pass 1 for this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
企业自定义部门 ID。
请确保该参数的唯一性。
默认生成根部门的id为1,因此请勿传1
parameters.name: out_dept_id

parameters.help_en:
The parent department ID.
The parent department ID cannot be the same as the department ID.
Ensure that the parent department information already exists in Alibaba Business Travel.
To place the new department under the root department, set this field to 1 or leave it empty
parameters.help_zh:
部门父部门 ID。
父部门 ID 不能与部门 ID 相同。
请确保父部门信息已经维护在阿里商旅。
如果想将新部门挂在根部门下面, 该字段传1或者不传都可以
parameters.name: out_dept_pid

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.
This is a required HTTP header parameter. For information about how to obtain it, refer to Enterprise access token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
You can use `corp_token=value` in the request URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。
是 HTTP 调用方式的 header 必填参数之一，获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。
可以在请求地址中使用 `corp_token=value` 替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token

requestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

traceId.description_en: The global trace ID of the request, typically used for troubleshooting
traceId.description_zh: 跟踪请求全局的标识符，通常用于问题排查定位
